candidates.name: Ceiling-A
candidates.role: ceiling assessment: idealized existing-system (NMC811/graphite) architecture + high-transport electrolyte + forced-air cooling; determines whether 500.94 Wh/kg is reachable without material change

llm_reason: Baseline ED 400.3 Wh/kg (contract caliber, electrolyte excluded) leaves a 100.6 Wh/kg gap. Before escalating to Stage 2 materials, quantify the existing-system ceiling: thin collectors (10/6 um vs 16/12), thin separator (9 um), thicker active layers (95/105 um), reduced porosity, smaller particles (rate/plating), high-sigma electrolyte 1.8 S/m, cooling h=100. If ceiling < 500.94 -> material escalation confirmed; if >= -> architecture route viable and T_max/plating decide. Params listed before run (protocol rule).
